author: Phob1an
local_changes: Renamed and separated as the starting point for the independent IRIX Classic theme.
Restored missing widgets/switch.svg from the author’s locally installed Irixium 6.2; retained the existing theme artwork.
Replaced Classic panel, tasks, pager, buttons, item highlights and sliders with opaque compact workstation plates; added state-specific hover/pressed artwork and vertical controls.
Replaced the inherited rounded/gradient switch with independently drawn mechanical rectangular Classic artwork; separated square task icon wells from caption strips inside a recessed Iconbox.
Recessed shared tray field and square analog-clock instrument socket; new flat clock artwork; pager frame centers are transparent so native window outlines remain visible above the opaque panel.

Late-1980s workstation surfaces: tiled integer-pixel stipple in gray panel housings and recessed teal fields; dark ruled edges and bitmap Iconbox heading, preserving panel geometry and native input handling.
